decision: User-requested glossy version of the clean blue sci-fi containment tube, intended as provisional visual decoration. The supplied clean source has 176,596 triangles and an opaque cyan chamber; textured orthographic views were inspected. A first trial reused the existing 9,000-triangle game mesh with a glossier roughness atlas, but the user screenshot showed a shattered top ring, gaps, and cyan leaking through. Surface changes cannot repair that geometry. The current delivery uses clean authored hard-surface geometry for the chamber, continuous top cap and rings, stepped base, and side control cabinet. Panel seams, roof ribs, vents, controls, fasteners, polished trim, blue enamel, and cyan glass/core recreate the most legible details from the concept. It is fitted to 12.1 studs with a ground pivot; all 10 meshes are under the per-mesh triangle cap. The user then requested separate green and neon-yellow internal variants. Each reuses the exact clean geometry and changes only core, glass and indicator material factors; the yellow core mesh is separately named for a Roblox Neon material check. The user later asked for a cracked chamber with material oozing out. That fourth separate variant derives from the neon-yellow export, cuts an opening into a new glass shell and adds fracture lines, retained shards, static viscous drips and a pool. Its 14 meshes meet the per-mesh cap, and the intact files are unchanged. The user next requested another blue version with only a faint suggestion of someone inside. A fifth separate variant keeps the clean blue assembly and adds a low-opacity static human silhouette between the opaque core and outer glass; no rigged character or animation is included. The first trial and both supplied/optimized sources remain preserved. Appearance, Studio transparency/gloss, owner, IDs, and map placement remain unapproved or unverified.
